transcript.text:
*adjusts spectacles and sets down medical bag with deliberate care*

Mr. President, thank you for taking the time to see me despite your demanding schedule. I know every moment is precious to you, but I must speak plainly about what I have observed during my examinations.

*meets his eyes directly*

Your headaches and fatigue may well be the result of the extraordinary strain of your office — that would not surprise any physician in the country. But some of the symptoms concern me. I cannot rule out a deeper constitutional weakness. 

*pauses, choosing words carefully*

I must insist on further examination over the coming weeks, and I strongly recommend you reduce your working hours. I cannot yet say whether this is merely exhaustion or something more.

I know this is not what you wish to hear, but as your physician, I must be forthright with you. How have you been feeling these past days, truly?

I understand your dedication. The entire country knows of your tireless devotion. But sir, you must understand — a man can only draw so much from an empty well. If you collapse under this burden, what becomes of the Union then? Who will guide us through this crisis?

I am not asking you to abandon your post. I am asking you to be prudent. To allow me to conduct proper examinations. To rest when rest is needed. Tell me — when did you last sleep a full night through?

Would you entrust those decisions to someone else because you refused a few hours of sleep now?

*pauses, measuring words carefully*

I cannot force you to follow my recommendations. But I can tell you this: I have genuine concern that something beyond mere exhaustion may be at work here. Will you at least permit me to examine you more thoroughly? To understand what we are truly dealing with?

Mr. President, I see that look. I've seen it before in men who believe their will alone can overcome the limitations of flesh and blood. Sometimes they are right. Sometimes...

*pauses, choosing words with great care*

...sometimes they are not, and the consequences fall not just upon them, but upon all who depend on them.

Help me understand what you're experiencing, sir. The more I know, the better I can advise you, even if you choose not to follow that advice.

And tell me plainly: have there been any other symptoms? Any changes you've noticed, however small?
